name: Linear Offset
summary: A virtual hand cursor whose offset grows in proportion to the head-to-hand distance, a linear version of Go-Go's arm extension.
howItWorks: The cursor is displaced along the head-to-hand direction by an amount proportional to how far the hand is from the head. For targets out of reach it outperformed the fixed-length and Go-Go offsets in the study; for targets within reach no offset was best.

relationships.note: A linear instead of quadratic arm-extension mapping.
